cost_note: Nobitex base USDT taker rate is a public current-rate counterfactual observed 2026-11-14, not account-verified. Wallex and Tabdeal 0.2% and received-base buy fees are explicit hypotheses, not verified rates or fee currencies. Sell fees are assumed quote-denominated. Zero-cost is a non-deployable diagnostic.
inventory_note: Synthetic independent capacity ceilings per comparison, not personal capital or a funded portfolio. No balances are mutated and estimates must never be summed as profit. Residual base is retained and valued at zero in the quote-cash comparison.
source_note: The catalog hash identifies the bounded public metadata observation. Native BTC/USDT identity, spot permission and full filters remain unverified. Missing source time or minimum notional blocks a strict comparison; unknown minimum quantity is disclosed.
selection: One prospective bounded recording after registration. Report every scenario and both directions, including exclusions; no parameter sweep, favorable window selection, automatic retry or performance acceptance. Positive base/stress estimates only justify later asynchronous two-leg paper research.
limitations: Snapshot liquidity, finite depth, receive/source timestamps and static inventory ceilings do not prove execution. No order latency, queue, both-leg failure, cash/inventory recycling, rebalancing/transfer costs, fiat attribution, funding, leverage or realized profit.
